desc: Read the input, build the adjacency list, and compute degrees for all vertices.
For each vertex `c` from 1 to N, collect the values `d_v = deg(v) - 1` for all neighbors `v` of `c`.
For each center `c`, sort the list of `d_v` values in descending order.

Iterate through possible `y` values for each center. To do this efficiently, note that the distinct values of `y` that matter are the values in the sorted list of `d_v` and potentially `d_v + 1` boundaries. Alternatively, iterate `y` from `max(d_v)` down to `1`, and maintain a pointer/index in the sorted list to count how many neighbors have `d_v >= y`.
For each `(c, y)` pair, compute `size = 1 + count * (1 + y)` and update the global maximum snowflake size.
